scripts.deploy:cdn: npm run build --workspace=omkara-cdn && wrangler pages deploy apps/cdn/dist --project-name omkara-cdn
scripts.deploy:storefront: npx @cloudflare/next-on-pages --experimental-minify -p apps/storefront && wrangler pages deploy apps/storefront/.vercel/output/static --project-name omkara-store
scripts.deploy:admin: npx @cloudflare/next-on-pages --experimental-minify -p apps/admin && wrangler pages deploy apps/admin/.vercel/output/static --project-name omkara-admin
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:cdn && npm run deploy:storefront && npm run deploy:admin
